notes: ↪ Redo: after ↩ Undo the step can be brought back (several in a row) — the ↪ Redo button in History, Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z (not while typing); a new edit clears Redo. 🔍 Timeline zoom: Alt + wheel (or a trackpad pinch) around the cursor, = / − / \ (fit), or the 1× button under ✂ (2–16×); all lanes scroll together, the plain wheel scrolls time, the playhead stays in view while playing. ⤢ Big timeline: taller lanes, full width. 🔊 Hold Cmd while dragging the playhead — you hear the sound under it (short grains, like After Effects).
